test_split: 159 items (manifest split == 'test'), event-grouped; dev split used only for runner smoke tests
analysis_plan: analyze_image_eval.py at this commit; primary outcome = false-support rate on non-supporting real images, visual-v2 vs legacy, paired exact McNemar; secondary = missed support, backfill coverage/correctness vs provisional class, visual coarse accuracy/macro-F1, text hazard-type agreement vs constructed claim, latency, tokens, cost. Reference labels are provisional/constructed until human annotation is complete. When adjudicated human labels exist, human_reference() in analyze_image_eval.py reports the same outcomes against them, plus evidence-tier error and severe-report review recall/false escalation/workload for both decision policies. Also pre-registered: analyze_ai_reference.py reports the same outcomes against ai_review/ai_review_labels.csv (one AI annotator; not human; no inter-annotator agreement), with the label-quality comparison of Commons categories against it.
no_tuning_statement: No prompt, policy or threshold may change between this record and the test-split run; run_image_eval.py refuses to run the test split if any frozen file differs.
